title: hello
description:
Handshake. Must be the first message on a connection; any other method before it is answered with `protocol.unsupported` (spec §5).

In v1 the plugin sends `hello` and the core answers — see OPEN_QUESTIONS.md §7 for why that direction and not the other.

version.description: The plugin's own version. Informational — compatibility is decided by `protocol` alone.

session.title: Session id
session.description: New on every connection, including reconnects. Useful for correlating both sides' logs across a drop.
